description: This file defines the AccessFlowStateMachineService class, which manages workflow state transitions, permissions, and caching for a human resource management system. It interacts with a Data Access Object (DAO) for database operations and provides methods to retrieve allowed actions, check permissions, handle workflow records, and manage cache related to workflow states.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineService
classes.description: Service class managing workflow state transitions, permissions, caching, and integration with DAO and other service classes within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the DAO responsible for database operations related to workflow state machines.

methods.name: setAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO instance for dependency injection.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of allowed actions for a given workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Provides cached or fresh list of workflow items permissible for a specific workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a specific action is allowed for a workflow, state, role combination.

methods.name: getNextState
methods.description: Determines the next state in a workflow given current state, role, and action.

methods.name: getAllAlowedRecruitmentApplicationStates
methods.description: Fetches all allowed recruitment application states for a specified workflow and role.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Retrieves states that can perform certain actions for a workflow and role.

methods.name: getWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Gets all the state machine records for a workflow, optionally filtered by role.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Persists a workflow state machine record.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecordAsArray
methods.description: Persists multiple workflow state machine records provided as an array.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Deletes a specific workflow state machine record based on parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedCandidateList
methods.description: Returns candidate list accessible for a specific user role and employee number (placeholder implementation).

methods.name: getAllowedProjectList
methods.description: Returns project list accessible for a specific user role and employee number (placeholder implementation).

methods.name: getAllowedVacancyList
methods.description: Returns vacancy list accessible for a specific user role and employee number (placeholder implementation).

methods.name: getAllowedCandidateHistoryList
methods.description: Returns candidate history list for a specific user role and employee number (placeholder implementation).

methods.name: getWorkflowItem
methods.description: Retrieves a workflow state machine record by its ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Retrieves a workflow state machine record for given workflow, state, action, and role.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Deletes workflow records associated with a specific user role.

methods.name: handleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Updates workflow records after renaming a user role.

methods.name: resetWorkflowCache
methods.description: Clears the internal cache of allowed workflow items.
